title: Wack 100: Tekashi 6ix9ine Takes Shots At King Von, PNB Rock, Gunna On Clubhouse
htmlContent:
On Thursday night, Wack 100 brought Tekashi 69 back to Clubhouse in the 100 ENT room. King Von's music was playing as a part of the playlist that was supposed to be played before 6ix9ine came in.
The room started with a song by King Von, and 69 quickly intercepted, saying cut that shit off; that n**** in hell is burning right now.[

Months ago, people close to the music industry and fans predicted Gunna would snitch (tell) 69 and said he has no views on it. It's clear as day, me and you (Young Thug) fighting a case. My role is not crazy as your role.

You don't have a plea like I have a plea. But once plead guilty, you admit to a crime. Anything you say under oath will be put on your man's.

You told the state the judge that your man’s was there, we was there, we did it. Only You and Jeffery was caught in the car, and we found a handgun and drugs. What did he say?

Wack 100 "What he covered on the bank robbery is what he covered on the Rico charge."

Wack admits he met Gunna before and he wasn't like that. So he is playing like he like that, but he is really not like that.

Sixty-nine told motherf***ers what he did. He hoped on the stands, he told what he did. I just seen Busta Rhymes on Ig saying, "Welcome Home King."

Wack: Thug, We ain't nothing but a label; Gunna basically went against what they was initially saying

69"I just got on an elevator and came to my hotel room by myself, they not catching me at no Waffle House."

6ix9ine is clearly referencing PNB Rock, who was murdered in Los Angeles at Roscoe's House of Chicken' N Waffles back in September, according to People Magazine.

Then Wack 100 asked 69 what he was facing (charges); he replied n***, look it up, you know what I was facing. I hate funny shit.

Alpo Martinez on street rat "You do what you have to do for you" I still did 25 years, and they say I'm telling. There is no code to the streets. "Call me a rat a government witness. Don't ever forget I'm a man."

Reek, another infamous snitch 69 y'all act like when it's me, y'all act like it's no internet yall turn a blind eye. "When y'all see me outside do something" I've been outside with wack 100 times. CEO Reek Known gang member and host Ceo Reek: "What if nobody is thinking about doing nothing to you?" G Homie 99 % of the neighborhood fear him, but he is coming out the back. But the government says he has been a reliable source since 1987.
